text_blocks.snippet: The time it takes for a COVID-19 test to show positive depends on the type of test used:

list.title: PCR Test:
list.snippet: Typically takes 1-3 days to receive results. It can detect the virus as early as 1-2 days after exposure.

list.title: Rapid Antigen Test:
list.snippet: Provides results in 15-30 minutes. It may not be as sensitive as PCR tests and may take longer to show positive if viral levels are low.

text_blocks.snippet: Factors that can affect the time it takes to test positive include:
The amount of virus present in the sample, The type of test used, and The laboratory processing time.
